params.name: schema
params.description: The schema to save the created table to. If no parameter is provided, defaults to "qm" if table_name is also not specified, and "public" otherwise.

params.name: table_name
params.description: The name that will be used to create the table produced by the query execution, if any. If not provided, defaults to a randomly generated name.

params.name: overwrite
params.description: Determines if the table shall be overwritten or not if it already exists.

params.name: max_results
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of records that should be returned in the result set (max: 100).

items.docs:
Executes queries using either a query string or a query template.

<Note>The `query_string` field holds direct queries or templates that can
be modified with specified parameters. You can also recall saved query
templates by their `template_id` or `template_name`. These templates, regardless
of how they are called, can be used with or without parameters.</Note>
